Name: Potions Extended - English Translation
Author: Arillume
Description:
This is an English Translation of the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26191]Potion Extend[/url]﻿ by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Skeleton0w0/about-me?gameId=1303]Skeleton0w0[/url]

Adds a new machine: Cauldron
Unlocks recipes for the cauldron when reaching foraging level 4.

Recipes added to the cauldron:
[code]﻿[spoiler]Put in 5 moss in the cauldron to produce Moss Sludge,
Put in 1 red mushroom to produce Red Mushroom Reagent,
Put in 1 purple mushroom to produce Purple Mushroom Reagent,
Put in 1 ginger to produce Concentrated Ginger Juice,
Put in 5 iridium ore to produce Iridium Crab Liquor,
Put in 1 gold bar to produce Blessed Potion,
Put in 1 cinder shard to produce Scalding Potion,
Put in 1 blobfish to produce Chilling Deep Sea Potion,
Put in 1 squid ink to produce Cursed Ink,
Put in 1 prismatic shard to produce Magic Syrup,
Put in 5 sap to produce Sticky Extract.[/spoiler]
[/code]
Adds a new recipe when reaching foraging level 6 which requires almost all potions added by this mod.
Drink with caution..

Downloads.Description: updated manifest, if you have already downloaded this mod before you are not required to download this as well as it will not impact gameplay.
